disclaimer: The sequence illustrates a typical honeycomb sandwich scarf repair. It does not specify temperature, pressure, time, materials, or dimensions.
geometry_note: Scarf the damage area to expose the plies, replace the core, and rebuild the stepped or tapered repair layers.

steps.title: Damage assessment and marking
steps.detail: Use ultrasonic and electromagnetic inspection to identify damage and mark the repair boundary.

steps.title: Scarf grinding and cleaning
steps.detail: Scarf the damaged facesheet and clean the surface for bonding.

steps.title: Core removal and replacement
steps.detail: Remove crushed or perforated core and insert a matching core plug.

steps.title: Adhesive film and repair plies
steps.detail: Place adhesive film and repair plies in sequence to rebuild the scarfed region.

steps.title: Vacuum bagging and curing
steps.detail: Apply a vacuum bag or local pressure and cure the repair. Only the consolidation concept is shown; process parameters are omitted.

steps.title: Post-repair inspection
steps.detail: Re-inspect the repair to close the inspect–repair–re-inspect workflow.
